sweeps.name: colocated
sweeps.narrative: The colocated control should hold ITL only with a chunked-prefill cap, and the wide-dp shapes should give the most tokens per GPU.

sweeps.name: pd-dp1
sweeps.narrative: Prefill-heavy ratios should win on 10k prompts, and a threshold near the median prompt should beat splitting every request.

sweeps.name: pd-always
sweeps.narrative: Splitting every request should cost ITL headroom against the threshold arms, because each handoff stalls a decode slot.

objective: max output tok/s per accelerator subject to the scenario's SLOs
